name: fastmon/shopware-collector
description: Real user monitoring for your Shopware storefront: Core Web Vitals, JavaScript errors and per-layer Server-Timing from real visitors. EU-hosted and cookieless.

suggest.ext-tideways: Tideways 5.23+ adds the per-layer breakdown (database, cache, search, outbound HTTP) to the Server-Timing header. Everything else the plugin reports needs no extension.

description.en-GB: Real user monitoring for your Shopware storefront: Core Web Vitals, JavaScript errors and per-layer Server-Timing from real visitors. EU-hosted and cookieless.
description.de-DE: Real User Monitoring für deine Shopware-Storefront: Core Web Vitals, JavaScript-Fehler und Server-Timing pro Layer von echten Besuchern. EU-gehostet, ohne Cookies.

scripts-descriptions.test: Unit suite: no shop, no database.
scripts-descriptions.test-integration: Integration suite: boots Shopware; run from inside a project (see README).
scripts-descriptions.ci: Everything that runs without a shop: style, static analysis, mess detection, unit suite.
